FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT count(*) members, sum((cur=0)::int) no_current, sum((open_ended<>cur)::int) flag_mismatch, sum((cur>1)::int) multi,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member a JOIN dim_member b ON a.member_id=b.member_id AND a.member_key<b.member_key AND a.valid_from<=b.valid_to AND b.valid_from<=a.valid_to) overlaps,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE member_key IS NULL) null_key,
 (SELECT count(*)-count(DISTINCT member_key) FROM dim_member) dup_keys,
 (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) max_sale, (SELECT max(valid_from) FROM dim_member) maxvf,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_member_updates) stg_rows
FROM m

SELECT home_store_id, count(*) gold_members, sum((join_date>DATE '2026-10-04')::int) future_join, sum((valid_from>DATE '2026-10-08')::int) future_ver
FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier='Gold' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT s.is_current, s.tier, count(*) n, count(d.member_key) key_in_dim, min(s.valid_from), max(s.valid_from)
FROM stg_member_updates s LEFT JOIN dim_member d ON d.member_key=s.member_key GROUP BY ALL

SELECT count(DISTINCT cm.member_id) active_gold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_member fm ON fm.member_key=f.member_key
JOIN dim_member cm ON cm.member_id=fm.member_id AND cm.is_current AND cm.tier='Gold'
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key AND s.store_id<>999
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2026-10-04' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2026-10-04'
